Questions before you start

What is free, what uses credits, and what you need to bring.

Is the free tier really free?

Yes — no credit card required. You get 5 storyboards per month, unlimited local GPU renders, and a complete video export. Free exports carry a small watermark; Pro removes it.

What’s the difference between free renders and paid platforms?

Local GPU renders use Ken Burns motion and are free for everyone. Premium engines — including Kling, Runway, Veo, Luma, Pika, and more — use pay-as-you-go credits.

Do I need to provide lyrics?

No, but the results are noticeably better when you do.

What happens if a render fails?

Your credits are automatically refunded. You never pay for a clip that didn’t come out.

What audio formats can I upload?

MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, FLAC, OGG, and more. Most common audio — and video — files are supported.

Do I have to subscribe?

No. Pro is an optional $6.99/month plan that lifts the storyboard limit and removes watermarks. Everything else uses pay-as-you-go credits.
